title: Days-to-Event Milestone Wall
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:countdown
| eval days_left=round((milestone_time-now())/86400,1)
| where days_left>=0
| table milestone milestone_time days_left
| sort days_left
description: Shows a countdown to every key milestone — dress fitting, final head count, rehearsal — on one wall.
value: A single milestone wall keeps everyone aligned and calm as the date approaches.
implementation: Ingest milestones into `index=personal`; compute days remaining to each.
visualization: Table of milestones ordered by days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It counts down the days to each big moment, so everyone knows what is coming and when.
